description.name: Telegram Notifications
description.tagline: Secure, real-time Telegram notifications for WHMCS events.
description.long: Telegram Notifications sends real-time alerts to a Telegram chat, group or channel when clients register, invoices are paid and support tickets are opened or replied to. Version 2 is hardened for WHMCS 9 and PHP 8.2+: client input is escaped, sensitive ticket content is opt-in, link previews are disabled and Telegram outages can never block checkout or payment callbacks.
features: Notifications when an invoice is paid.
Notifications when a support ticket is opened (including guest tickets).
Notifications when a client replies to a support ticket, with optional reply preview.
HTML-escaped messages that block link and markup injection.
Non-blocking delivery with strict timeouts and error isolation.
Built-in log viewer showing delivery status for each notification.
